get.summary: The signed-in user, the household of this request and all their households. The first call creates the user and a household.

put.summary: Change the display name, language or time zone.

delete.summary: Delete the account, its sign-in and the households nobody else would keep, if the households' fates are still the plan from GET /me/deletion (else 409 deletion-plan-changed). Needs a sign-in in the last 5 minutes: 403 recent-sign-in-required.

get.summary: What deleting the account would do to each household: deleted with everything in it, kept by the others, or handed over to a member.
Everything of the user's as a ZIP: account.json, and each household's household.json with its photos and scans.
The households the user is in, with their role in each. The app names the one it shows in the X-Household header of every request; without it, the first one.

post.summary: A new household with the user as its owner, e.g. "Office". 409 household-limit.

get.summary: The household of this request: its people and their roles; for owners also the open invites.

put.summary: Rename the household or set its time zone (feeding times and reminders are in it). Owners only.

delete.summary: Delete a household made by mistake: only an empty one (no pets, supplies or files) of one person. 409 household-not-empty. Owners only.

put.summary: Give someone another role. Owners only; 409 last-owner when the household would be left without one.

delete.summary: Leave the household (your own id), or, as an owner, remove someone. 409 last-owner for the last owner.

post.summary: A one-time code to join this household as a member or a helper, valid for 7 days. Owners only. 409 invite-limit.

delete.summary: Take an invite back before someone uses it. Owners only.

post.summary: What a code invites to: the household, who invites and the role. 404 when it's wrong, used, taken back or expired.
Join the household of the code with its role. 404 when the code is wrong, used, taken back or expired; 409 already-a-member or household-limit. Safe to repeat.

get.summary: Pets of the signed-in user's household: active first, then by when they were added.

post.summary: Add a pet.

get.summary: One pet.

put.summary: Replace the pet's details and identifiers.

delete.summary: Delete the pet with its passport, documents and files. This can't be undone.

put.summary: Use an uploaded photo as the pet's photo; the previous photo is deleted.

get.summary: The pet's weight log, newest first: its weighings and the weights noted in its care records.

post.summary: Add a weighing.

get.summary: One weighing.
The header of the pet's digital passport copy (empty until saved).

put.summary: Save the passport header: model, number, country, issue date, issuing vet, owners.

post.summary: Upload a photo (JPEG, PNG, WebP) or a PDF, up to 15 MB.
post.description: Photos are stored as JPEG without metadata, at most 2048 px on the long side, with a thumbnail. Attach the file to a pet or a document next; files that are never attached are deleted after a day.

get.summary: Fresh download links for a file of the household.
The pet's documents, newest first; optionally only one type, such as PassportPage.

post.summary: Create a document from uploaded files; the order of fileIds is the page order.

get.summary: One document with links to its pages.

put.summary: Change the document's type, title, date and notes. The pages stay as they are.

delete.summary: Delete the document and its files.

post.summary: Add uploaded files as pages at the end of the document.

delete.summary: Delete one page and its file. Deleting the last page deletes the document.

get.summary: Ready-made plans with default intervals; with species, only the ones that suit it.
The health sections of the digital passport copy (V–X), built from the care records.
Today's feedings, planned visits, care overdue or due within 30 days for all active pets, and what to buy.

The pet's scans still waiting for the user (being read, ready to check, or failed), newest first, to pick one up again. notes=true: notes only; notes=false: photo scans only; each kind has its own newest 20.
What a scanned barcode is: the household's item with it, or the product from the catalog, Open Pet Food Facts or UPCitemdb.

post.summary: Read photos of a package with AI: name, brand, size, energy, and for a medicine how long a dose protects. Waits for the answer (up to a few minutes). 409 urn:collarbell:problem:ai-limit: not enough AI photos left this month; 409 without a type: AI isn't set up; 429: too many AI requests in a minute; 503: all models are busy.

Read the microchip and tattoo numbers on photos of a passport page or a chip sticker with AI, to fill in the pet form; nothing is saved. Waits for the answer (up to a few minutes). 409 urn:collarbell:problem:ai-limit: not enough AI photos left this month; 409 without a type: AI isn't set up; 429: too many AI requests in a minute; 503: all models are busy.
What the app did and saw (screens, actions, errors), up to 50 at a time; kept for a week for support.

get.summary: The household's plan (Free or Premium), this month's AI photos and the limit. Premium is given by hand for now; there are no payments yet.

post.summary: A one-time ticket to open the live updates' hub from a browser: /hubs/household?access_token=<ticket>&household=<id>. Good once, for a minute; 429 with ten unused.

get.summary: The pet's plans with their status: active first, soonest due first.

post.summary: Add a plan, from a preset or your own.

get.summary: One plan.

put.summary: Change a plan, including its next date.

delete.summary: Delete a plan. The records it created stay in the history.

post.summary: "Done": add a record and move the plan to its next date (a one-off plan finishes).

get.summary: The pet's care history, newest first; optionally one kind only.

post.summary: Add a record by hand, for example from the paper passport.

get.summary: One record.

put.summary: Change a record. Its photos stay as they are.

delete.summary: Delete a record and its photos. A plan it completed keeps its date.

post.summary: Attach uploaded files (the vaccine sticker, the vet's conclusion).

get.summary: Which AI models read photos, whether they are set up, and this month's use by the household.

post.summary: Check that a model answers and can see a picture. The picture counts as one of the month's AI photos; 409 urn:collarbell:problem:ai-limit: none left; 429: too many AI requests in a minute.

Start reading uploaded photos of the passport (or a vet document), or a note, with AI. Poll the import until it is Ready. 409 urn:collarbell:problem:ai-limit: not enough AI photos left this month; 409 without a type: AI isn't set up; 429: too many AI requests in a minute, or with urn:collarbell:problem:text-limit too many notes today.

get.summary: The scan's status, photos and draft.

delete.summary: Throw the scan away; its photos are deleted with other unused uploads after a day. A saved scan can't be thrown away (409): what it saved stays.

post.summary: Save what the user checked: records, weighings, identifiers, passport fields, and the photos as scans.

get.summary: The pet's feeding schedules, active ones first.

post.summary: Add a feeding schedule: times of day, days of the week, food and portion.

get.summary: One feeding schedule.

put.summary: Change a feeding schedule; its reminders follow.

delete.summary: Delete a feeding schedule and its marks.

post.summary: "Fed" (or "skipped") for one feeding. 409 with who did it when someone else marked it first.

delete.summary: Take a mark back, e.g. the wrong pet was tapped.

get.summary: Visits, optionally of one pet: planned ones first (soonest first), then past and cancelled (newest first).

post.summary: Add a visit; reminders come a day and two hours before by default.

get.summary: One visit.

put.summary: Change a visit, cancel it or plan it again.

delete.summary: Delete a visit. Records made from it stay.

post.summary: "The visit took place": optionally a care record for each pet and "Done" for their plans.

put.summary: Register this phone for pushes (its id is chosen by the app once); call again when its token changes.

delete.summary: Stop pushes to this phone, e.g. on sign-out.

get.summary: Which kinds of reminders the signed-in person gets, and on which phones.

put.summary: Turn kinds of reminders on or off.

get.summary: The household's reminders: the next 7 days, and what happened in the last 7.

post.summary: Send a test push to the signed-in person's phones now.

get.summary: The household's supplies with their estimates: what runs out first comes first, items no longer bought last.

post.summary: Add a food, litter or medication to supplies, with what is there now.

get.summary: One supply item with its estimate and the feedings that use it.

put.summary: Change a supply item; the stock stays as entered.

delete.summary: Delete a supply item and its purchases; feedings keep the food's name.

get.summary: The item's purchases and counts, newest first (the last 50).

post.summary: "Bought two bags" or "about half a bag left"; answers with the new estimate. A purchase of an item no longer bought makes it bought again.

delete.summary: Take back a purchase or a count entered by mistake.
